skill.name: god-build
skill.description: Implement a planned change test first, track progress in project notes, and record the final verification result.
skill.summary: Build planned changes one step at a time with tests.
skill.author: hannsxpeter

security_audit.summary: Both findings are confirmed as external command risks: the backticks format Markdown, but the instructions explicitly tell the agent to run the commands. Both calls can fetch and execute an npm package using a major-version selector without an installation prompt. No evidence found of prompt injection or intentional data exfiltration.

remediation.issue: The skill requests non-interactive execution of an npm package without an exact version pin.
remediation.suggestion: Use a reviewed local dependency pinned to an exact version in a lockfile. Ask for approval before downloading or executing external packages.

remediation.issue: The final check passes a project verification command to the package.
remediation.suggestion: Require review of the exact command and its source before execution. Prefer a known local test script over a free-form command string.

content.value_statement: It can be hard to tell what was tested when a plan spans several changes. This skill builds one step at a time and records the final project check.
actual_capabilities: Selects a named or unchecked plan step, or works from the requirements in the request.
Writes or extends a targeted test and checks that it fails before implementing the change.
Runs targeted tests and calls for a fast check after each step.
Marks completed plan steps and records lasting design decisions in project notes.
Allows independent steps that touch different files to be delegated when the host supports subagents.
Records the final verification result, updates the project stage to review, and reports remaining work.
limitations: The fast and recorded checks use an npm helper selected by major version, not an exact release.
The skill relies on the project for a test setup and a suitable verification command.
A nontrivial change without a plan or requirements may need the separate god-plan skill.
Parallel delegation depends on the host supporting subagents with explicit model and effort settings.

use_cases.title: Fix a Bug with a Regression Test
use_cases.description: Reproduce a reported bug with a failing test, then make the smallest change that passes it.

use_cases.title: Resume a Partially Completed Plan
use_cases.description: Continue from the next unchecked step and report which work remains.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Independent Changes
use_cases.description: Delegate steps that touch separate files and run one final project check before review.

prompt_templates.title: Fix One Bug
prompt_templates.prompt: Use god-build to fix [bug]. Show the targeted test failing first, then make it pass. Ask before running any external package.
prompt_templates.scenario: A small change with a clear expected result.

prompt_templates.title: Resume the Next Plan Step
prompt_templates.prompt: Use god-build to implement the next unchecked step. Run the targeted project tests and report what remains. Ask before running any external package.
prompt_templates.scenario: A project already has an implementation plan.

prompt_templates.title: Separate a Refactor from a Behavior Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Use god-build to implement [feature] in separate refactor and behavior steps. Record design decisions and propose the final verification command for approval.
prompt_templates.scenario: A feature requires a structural change before behavior can change.

prompt_templates.title: Delegate Independent Steps
prompt_templates.prompt: Use god-build to delegate [step A] and [step B] only if they touch different files. Review the combined result and request approval before running the final external check.
prompt_templates.scenario: A host with subagents is handling two independent steps.

output_examples.input: Fix duplicate entries in the import preview using the next plan step.
output_examples.output: The regression test failed on duplicate entries and passed after the fix. The plan step is complete. The recorded project check is pending approval.

output_examples.input: Finish the planned parser and documentation updates, then run the approved project check.
output_examples.output: Both steps are complete. The final project check passed, the project stage is set to review, and no build steps remain.

best_practices: Define what each step must demonstrate before implementation starts.
Review the npm helper and the exact verification command before approving either for execution.
Keep refactoring separate from behavior changes and record lasting decisions in the project notes.
anti_patterns: Weakening, skipping, or deleting a test to make a check pass.
Delegating steps that edit the same files at the same time.
Treating an interim fast check as the recorded final verification.

faq.question: Do I need a written plan?
faq.answer: No. The skill can use requirements from your request. For nontrivial work without clear requirements, it directs the agent to run god-plan first.

faq.question: What does test first mean here?
faq.answer: The agent writes or extends a targeted test, observes it fail, and then makes the smallest suitable change to pass it.

faq.question: Which project notes does it update?
faq.answer: It marks completed steps in PLAN.md if present, records decisions in DECISIONS.md, and sets the review stage in STATE.md after verification.

faq.question: What is the difference between a fast check and final verification?
faq.answer: The fast check runs after each step without recording a result. Final verification records the project check against the finished changes.

faq.question: Can the skill download and run external code?
faq.answer: Yes. The npm helper can be downloaded and run without an installation prompt. Review the package and authorize its use before running the checks.

faq.question: Does this skill perform the final code review?
faq.answer: No. It prepares the project for review after verification and suggests the separate god-review skill.
